entries.label: Golden render smoke
prerequisites: Read-only candidate checkout and protected evaluator revision recorded
Node 22 and frozen pnpm dependencies provisioned
UPDATE_GOLDEN must be unset; protected named baseline coverage required
Record font and render environment; missing mandatory baselines yield not_run
entries.failureMeaning: A demo render fails XML validation or a present normalized baseline differs.
entries.limitations: Missing baselines skip. Production XML validation and normalized byte equality cannot prove numeric meaning.

entries.label: Exact SDK package consumer
prerequisites: Node 22.22.1, npm and local Chrome provisioned
Trusted runner stages exact compiled candidate tarball at .promote-inputs/candidate.tgz and records SHA-256 before execution
Temporary consumer directory writable; dependency installation/network explicitly provisioned
Packaged reference fonts and workspace dependencies available
entries.failureMeaning: The exact installed package fails a covered Node, CLI, declaration, React, browser or financial consumer check.
entries.limitations: Creates a temporary consumer and installs dependencies. Full oracle independence is unreviewed; Node/CLI parity shares package implementation. Does not regenerate arbitrary original incident input or prove activation/repeat benefit.
